title: Catherine model document v1 (.ct.json)
description: Syntactic surface of the Catherine model document format v1. This artifact covers ONLY the schema-expressible checks: missing required fields, JSON type mismatches, the equation status enum, ident-pattern violations, and duplicate array-identifiers (via uniqueItems). Semantic checks that cross-reference user declarations — unknown arrows in equation paths (unknown_arrow) and ill-typed equations whose path endpoints do not match (ill_typed_equation) — remain kernel-side (crates/catherine-core parse). Unknown major format_version values are also kernel-side: this artifact accepts any MAJOR.MINOR shape, the parser accepts only majors it knows (v1), so editors can validate shape offline while the kernel remains the version authority.

format_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Additive change = minor version; breaking change = a new extension, never an in-place mutation of v1. Whether the major is known (v1) is checked kernel-side.

objects.description: Declared objects; duplicates are duplicate array-identifiers (editor-side here, kernel-side as duplicate_ident).

status.description: Defaults to accepted when absent; the semantic split (violations vs hypotheses) is a P1 concern and is not expressed here.

additionalProperties.description: Per-object row names; duplicates are duplicate array-identifiers.

oneOf.description: Dangling reference — preserved as a value, never dropped or repaired.

schema_map.description: Additive 1.1 (Δ migration axis, add-delta-migration phase A): the total map of the document schema into a target schema. Totality and assignment-target declaredness are kernel-side (partial_schema_map); this artifact covers only the syntactic surface.

oneOf.description: Explicit drop — the element is discarded, loudly, never silently.
The composable target path, spelled arrow by arrow.

path.description: A composable arrow sequence; whether every arrow is declared and the endpoints match is kernel-side (unknown_arrow / ill_typed_equation).
